info.title: Aivoryx Platform API
info.description: Code-first OpenAPI contract. Regenerate with `pnpm contracts:generate`.

cookie.name: aivoryx_session
cookie.description: HTTP-only session cookie (ADR 0010). Set by the auth endpoints in Phase 2.

permissions.description: Permission keys granted in this tenant.

roles.description: Role keys held in this tenant.

active.description: Null until the session has a usable active tenant.

tenantAutoSelected.description: True when the single-membership user was auto-selected into a tenant.

active.description: Null until the session has a usable active tenant.

membershipId.description: A membership id belonging to the current user.

active.description: Null until the session has a usable active tenant.

invitationPending.description: True while an invitation for this membership is still pending.

token.description: One-time invitation token. Returned ONLY here (no email provider is configured); relay it to the invitee out of band.
The one-time token from the invitation link.

password.description: Required only when the invited account has no password yet.

customFields.description: Tenant custom-field values, keyed by field key.

fieldMapping.description: Provider field -> "canonical:<field>" | "custom:<key>" | "skip" overrides, merged over the built-in defaults.

secret.description: One-time connector secret. Returned ONLY here (create / rotate); send it to Pabbly as the "Authorization: Bearer <secret>" header. Never returned again.
